mapper.select: SELECT PROGRAM_ID, PROGRAM_NAME, SYSTEM_CODE, MODULE_CODE FROM LGCOM_PROGRAM_M WHERE PROGRAM_TYPE_CODE = 'BATCH' AND PROGRAM_ID = #{programId}
SELECT LGCOM_BATCH_LOG_SEQ.NEXTVAL AS REQUEST_ID FROM DUAL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LGCOM_BATCH_LOG ( request_id, program_id, batch_id, schedule_flag, request_user_id, actual_start_date, argument_text, status_code, pop_up_alarm_flag, user_check_flag, created_by, creation_date, last_updated_by, last_update_date ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{programId}, #{batchId}, NVL( #{scheduleFlag}, 'N'), #{requestUserId}, SYSDATE, substrb(#{argumentText}, 1, 1999), 'R', 'N', 'N', #{requestUserId}, SYSDATE, #{requestUserId}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE LGCOM_BATCH_LOG SET actual_end_date = SYSDATE, status_code = #{statusCode}, error_flag = #{errorFlag}, error_content = #{errorContent}, last_updated_by = #{requestUserId}, last_update_date = SYSDATE WHERE request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.select: SELECT batch_id, system_code, module_code, program_id, batch_name, argument_text, request_start_date, submit_interval, submit_interval_unit_code, submit_interval_type_code, 'N' as job_working_flag, run_alone_flag, hold_flag, created_by as request_user_id , target_count, NVL( case when submit_interval_type_code = 'START' then case when target_count <= start_count then 0 else start_count end else case when target_count <= end_count then 0 else end_count end end , 0 ) as running_count from( SELECT lbm.batch_id, lbm.system_code, lbm.module_code, lbm.program_id, argument_text, to_char(request_start_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss' ) as request_start_date, batch_name, submit_interval, submit_interval_unit_code, submit_interval_type_code, 'N' as job_working_flag, run_alone_flag, hold_flag, 0 as running_count, created_by, decode(SUBMIT_INTERVAL_UNIT_CODE, 'MINUTE', 60, 'HOUR', 3600, 'DAY', 86400) * submit_interval / 30 as target_count, mod(floor( (sysdate - lbm.request_start_date ) * 3600 * 24 / 30 ), decode(SUBMIT_INTERVAL_UNIT_CODE, 'MINUTE', 60, 'HOUR', 3600, 'DAY', 86400) * submit_interval / 30) as start_count, mod(floor( (sysdate - lbm.request_start_date ) * 3600 * 24 / 30 ), decode(SUBMIT_INTERVAL_UNIT_CODE, 'MINUTE', 60, 'HOUR', 3600, 'DAY', 86400) * submit_interval / 30) as end_count FROM lgcom_batch_m lbm WHERE lbm.request_start_date <= sysdate and nvl(lbm.request_end_date, sysdate) >= sysdate and nvl(lbm.hold_flag,'N') = 'N' ) schedule
